title: Director of Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement
description:
Job Description

Position: Director of Manufacturing & Continuous Improvement
Location: Remote, must be located near a major airport
Compensation: $150-175K base salary + 20% bonus

Overview

GSD’s client is seeking a Director of Manufacturing & Continuous Improvement (CI) to lead multi-plant operations and drive a culture of safety, efficiency, and continuous improvement. This role partners closely with Plant Managers to implement Lean initiatives, enhance operational processes, and ensure accountability at every level of the organization.

The ideal candidate is hands-on, highly accountable, and experienced in building revitalized operations, not just short-term turnarounds. This leader will instill a culture of ownership and pride across the company’s plants.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Continuous Improvement (CI) initiatives in collaboration with Plant Managers.

  • Establish and maintain high standards for safety, process, and infrastructure.

  • Implement and coach LEAN tools and methodologies across all levels of the organization.

  • Drive process improvement projects from the shop floor to executive leadership.

  • Lead efforts in capacity planning, analysis, and operational planning.

  • Ensure accountability and performance alignment across multiple facilities.

  • Travel approximately 3 weeks per month to be visible and engaged at plant locations.

Candidate Profile

  • Proven leadership in Operations Management, Plant Management, or related roles.

  • Strong background in LEAN and Continuous Improvement practices.

  • Demonstrated success in capacity analysis, process optimization, and organizational planning.

  • Effective at influencing and engaging people at all levels, from frontline staff to leadership.

  • Decisive and pragmatic — able to set expectations and guide teams to execution.

  • Engineering or technical experience is beneficial, though not required.

Cultural Fit

  • Values safety, efficiency, and long-term process improvement.

  • Naturally drives accountability while remaining approachable and relatable.

  • Focused on revitalization and sustainability, not just reactive fixes.

title: IT Project Manager
description:
GSD Search has been engaged to identify a high level PM to join a healthcare client in Brentwood / Franklin. This is a contract with the possibility of conversion.

 

Consulting IT Project Manager (Operations & Change Management)

Type: Contract (6 months)
Location: Greater Nashville, TN — Hybrid (on-site ~2 days/week in Cool Springs/Franklin; specific days flexible)

Overview

We’re hiring a consulting IT Project Manager to parachute into an active transformation portfolio and keep high-visibility, executive-facing initiatives moving. You’ll coordinate cross-functional work across Clinical Operations, Finance, HR/TA, and Enterprise Technology; wrangle complex calendars and workshops; and drive structured change management and adoption for projects with significant operational impact.

This role is ideal for a polished consultant who’s comfortable with ambiguity, fast pace, and C-suite exposure—and who balances strategic facilitation with tactical, day-to-day project execution.

What You’ll Tackle (Initial Portfolio)

  • Operating model & division reorganization: Align systems, processes, and reporting structures to a three-division model (East/Central/West); partner closely with HRIS, Finance, and IT to implement org, security, and workflow changes.

  • Transformation Office cadence: Own a bi-weekly executive forum (Clinical Ops, Finance, Tech) including agenda, materials, KPIs, and action tracking; maintain momentum between meetings.

  • Revenue cycle/billing enablement: Support operational programs tied to public-sector reimbursement models (e.g., Medicaid 1115 waiver–related efforts), coordinating requirements across billing, EHR, and client operations.

Core Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary client-facing PM for assigned initiatives; facilitate executive sessions and stakeholder workshops; maintain clear, concise communications and decision logs.

  • Build & manage integrated project plans, RAID registers, dependency maps, and cutover/adoption plans; keep scope, timeline, and outcomes tightly governed.

  • Lead change management (stakeholder analysis, communications, training, and adoption metrics) leveraging Prosci/ADKAR or similar methods.

  • Drive meeting logistics end-to-end (calendars, rooms, virtual sessions, materials, follow-ups); ensure the right people are in the room at the right time.

  • Produce crisp executive decks and portfolio status (KPIs, decisions needed, risks, budget/burn).

  • Coordinate vendor/SI activities, NDAs/SOW support, demos, and proof-of-concepts; hold vendors accountable to milestones and deliverables.

  • Partner with HRIS/Finance/IT for configuration changes (org structures, roles, integrations, security); translate business needs into actionable requirements and stories.

  • Clear roadblocks creatively in a high-tempo environment where access to stakeholders can be challenging and priorities shift.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Consulting background (agency/Big-4/mid-tier boutique or equivalent client-facing delivery) with strong polish and stakeholder presence.

  • 5–8+ years of IT project management with material operations/change management experience.

  • Demonstrated success driving C-suite–facing initiatives and facilitating executive decision-making.

  • Hands-on PM fundamentals: plan/build, drive, and do the work (not just advise).

  • Experience with one or more: ERP/R2R/O2C/P2P, HRIS/Workday/UKG, EHR/clinical or billing systems, public-sector reimbursement contexts.

  • Tools: MS Project or Smartsheet, PowerPoint (exec-level), Jira/Confluence, SharePoint/Teams.

  • Excellent written/verbal communication; meeting design, storytelling, and slide craft.

Nice to Have

  • Prosci/ADKAR, PMP, or Agile credentials (CSM, SAFe).

  • Exposure to Medicaid/Medicare billing or 1115 waiver programs (or similar public-sector funding models).

  • Experience landing org restructures (division realignments, cost centers, security roles).

  • Prior work coordinating large vendors/SIs through RFP, selection, and implementation planning.

Work Style & Fit

  • Flexible, creative problem-solver who can operate without heavy PMO scaffolding.

  • Thrives in fast-paced, “trauma-unit” environments—able to prioritize, re-sequence, and keep momentum.

  • Comfortable being on-site ~2 days/week to make sessions meaningful and unblock decisions.

Engagement Details

  • Start: ASAP (flexible around key stakeholder availability)

  • Term: 6 months with likely extension based on portfolio needs

  • Rate: Competitive consulting rate commensurate with experience

title: Manager Lease Accounting
description:
Responsible for managing the global lease process, including timely and accurate reporting, and ensuring adequate and proper financial reporting, adhering to US GAAP and internal controls.

Essential Job Duties

  • Provide strategic leadership and oversight for the global lease accounting function, ensuring consistent application of ASC 842 and other relevant standards across all regions and entities.
  • Own and maintain global lease accounting policies, procedures, and controls to ensure accuracy, compliance, and operational efficiency across the organization.
  • Lead the review and interpretation of complex lease arrangements, providing technical accounting guidance and ensuring proper classification, measurement, and disclosure.
  • Direct global lease accounting activities within the monthly, quarterly, and annual close cycles, including review and approval of journal entries, account reconciliations, and internal reporting.
  • Oversee global lease schedules and the integrity of data within the Lease Accounting Application, ensuring alignment with contractual terms and accounting standards.
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders (e.g., Real Estate, Legal, FP&A, Fleet and Logistics, IT) to ensure accurate lease data capture, contract compliance, and proactive support for business initiatives.
  • Lead the preparation and review of lease-related financial disclosures and audit deliverables for external reporting and ensure timely response to internal and external audit requests.
  • Manage a global team of lease accountants, providing coaching, performance feedback, and development opportunities to build a high-performing, knowledgeable function.
  • Drive continuous improvement through process standardization, automation, and system enhancements; lead initiatives to streamline global lease accounting operations.
  • Monitor emerging accounting guidance and industry best practices, assessing implications and leading implementation of updates to global policies and processes.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for lease accounting matters with senior finance leadership, external auditors, and internal control functions.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in reviewing complex lease agreements and interpreting terms for proper accounting treatment.
  • Support enterprise-level initiatives, including M&A and Divestiture transactions, ensuring lease accounting considerations are effectively managed.
  • Champion a culture of accountability, accuracy, and continuous learning across the global lease accounting function.
  • Assume other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities

Manage the work of others, including planning, assigning, scheduling, and reviewing work, ensuring quality standards. Responsible for hiring, terminating, training and developing, reviewing performance and administering corrective action for staff.

Minimum Requirements

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting.
  • 5 years of related experience required; Fully competent professional; In-depth knowledge and experience.
  • CPA certification.

Preferred Requirements

  • 3 years supervisory experience.
  • Experience with FinQuery Lease software.
  • Experience in a corporate accounting environment.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

  • Knowledge of U.S. GAAP and FASB regulations and procedures as they relate to accounting.
  • Ability to formulate policy and document processes and procedures.
  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rates, ratios, and percentages and to draw and interpret graphs.
  • Frequent use of Outlook, Word, Excel, graphics, etc. Ability to create, maintain, and incorporate functions into Word documents, Excel spreadsheets, databases, and PowerPoint presentations to support business objectives.
  • Frequently communicates complex information across departments and interacts with management. Can present, resolve, and address delicate situations. Can motivate and persuade others.
  • Problems are varied and complex, requiring analysis or interpretation of the situation. Problems are solved using knowledge and skills, general precedents, and practices.
  • Decisions impact the management and operations within a department or business unit. May contribute to business and operational decisions that affect the department.
  • Provides and sets goals and priorities for the functional area. May make recommendations for department policies, practices, and programs. Makes decisions for and/or resolves problems for others.
  • Handle multiple tasks or projects simultaneously with moderate complexity.

Essential Physical Demands/Work Environment

  • Work is primarily sedentary: must be able to sit for extended periods and use a computer, keyboard, and mouse, frequently.
  • Travel may be required periodically, including overnight stays (contingent on position requirements).
  • Must be able to lift up to 25 pounds.

Benefits

  • Health/Dental/Vision Insurance
  • Paid Time Off
  • 401k with Generous Company Match
  • Company Paid Life Insurance and Long-Term Disability
  • Short-Term Disability
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Employee Discounts

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that celebrates diversity and promotes equity for all employees, candidates, clients, and partners.

title: Human Resource Coordinator II
description:
GSD Search has been engaged to identify a HR Services professional for a contract through the end of this year. Take a look below to apply OR share with someone that is interested! 

Contract -- 12/31 End Date

$20-24/HR

Hybrid

Job Summary 

Serve as the first point of contact for HR inquiries, providing Tier 1 support to employees via Workday Help, phone, and email. Responsible for resolving routine HR questions (pay, benefits, policies, onboarding, data updates), maintaining accurate case documentation, and escalating complex issues to the appropriate Tier 2 or COE partner. This role is central to delivering a positive employee experience and ensuring compliance with HR processes and regulations.

Essential Job Duties

  • Review and respond to Workday Help cases and inbound HR phone calls, resolving at Tier 1 where possible or escalating appropriately.
  • Provide accurate, timely, and professional responses to employee questions regarding pay, benefits, onboarding, policies, and general HR inquiries.
  • Track and document all case activity and manager self-service events in Workday Help, ensuring accurate routing and escalation.
  • Identify recurring issues and share insights with HRIS, Payroll, and COEs to improve processes.
  • Support compliance requirements including I-9, background scoring, labor law posters, and other HR-related compliance tasks.
  • Assist with benefits enrollment for new hires/rehires and provide guidance on employee benefit questions.
  • Provide employee data and information as requested by Legal and HR Business Partners.
  • Ensure employee data integrity, confidentiality, and adherence to service-level targets for case resolution.
  • Contribute to Tier 0 content (FAQs, knowledge base articles) to improve employee self-service and reduce repeat inquiries.
  • Provide support in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure system accuracy and functionality for new releases and system configuration changes.
  • Assume other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities

Not responsible for supervising employees.

Minimum Requirements

Education & Experience

  • High School Diploma/GED.
  • 1 year of related experience required.

Preferred Requirements

  • Workday experience
  • Associate's Degree

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rates, ratios, and percentages and to draw and interpret graphs.
  • Frequent use of Outlook, Word, Excel, graphics, etc. Ability to create, maintain and incorporate functions into Word documents, Excel spreadsheets, databases, and PowerPoint presentations to support business objectives.
  • Regularly uses moderately complex oral and written skills. May train others in functional areas, interact with others and make presentations to department or middle management.
  • Problems encountered are routine, somewhat repetitive and generally solved by following clear directions and procedures.
  • Decisions generally affect own job or assigned functional area.
  • Results are defined; sets personal own goals and determines how to achieve results with few or no guidelines to follow; supervisor/manager provides broad guidance and overall direction.
  • Handle multiple tasks or projects simultaneously with moderate complexity.
  • No additional competencies required.

Essential Physical Demands/Work Environment

  • Work is primarily sedentary: must be able to sit for extended periods of time and use a computer, keyboard, and mouse, frequently.
  • Travel may be required periodically, including overnight stays (contingent on position requirements).
  • The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.
